Open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code, expand the notification and tap Enter pairing code. If input is unavailable, use split screen and enter it in the app dialog.
Keep the system pairing code page open and enter its 6 digits here. If both screens cannot be shown together, use split screen first.
